name: What certifications or qualifications should an unattended death cleanup company have?

mainEntity.name: What certifications or qualifications should an unattended death cleanup company have?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reputable unattended death cleanup company should have specific certifications and qualifications to ensure safe and effective remediation. Look for certifications from recognized industry bodies such as the Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification (IICRC) for various restoration categories, and proof of OSHA compliance for biohazard handling and worker safety. Technicians should be trained in Bloodborne Pathogen (BBP) removal, hazardous waste disposal, and proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and disinfectants. These credentials indicate adherence to strict safety and health standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: A reputable cleanup company should have IICRC certifications, OSHA compliance, and technicians trained in Bloodborne Pathogen removal, hazardous waste disposal, and PPE use, ensuring safe and effective remediation.
